description: Returns the federal average prime offer rate (APOR) for a week and loan term from the FFIEC tables.

kind.description: Fixed or adjustable rate table. The default is fixed.

term.description: Loan term in years from 1 to 50. The default is 30 years.

week.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. The result uses the benchmark for the week on or before this date.

name: get_benchmark_rate
title: get benchmark rate
